purpose: The KYC service performs identity checks for customers, including opening cases, uploading documents, and managing the status of cases through a centralized orchestrator.

components.name: kyc-orchestrator
components.evidence: kyc-orchestrator owns the case records in kyc-db (PostgreSQL) and the images in the kyc-documents bucket (S3).

components.name: kyc-db
components.evidence: kyc-db has point-in-time recovery enabled, with seven days of retention.

components.name: kyc-documents
components.evidence: Uploaded files are scanned for malware before any other user or service can open them.

components.name: vendor
components.evidence: The vendor answers asynchronously. The case moves from open to submitted, and then to approved, rejected or needs_review.
